subtitle: A complete, worked SOX-focused SAP controls project from landscape to conclusion.
study_load: 14 linked workbooks plus case, manuals and practice
learning_principle: Work through the engagement in dependency order. Each downstream workbook relies on source keys and evidence from upstream workbooks. Gates control progression.

groups.label: Stage 1 — Understand the Environment
groups.summary: Build the factual landscape and interface scope. Gate G1.

items.title: Landscape & System Inventory
items.description: Identify the systems, clients, company codes, production status and transport routes that form the project landscape.
items.gate_requirement: All financially relevant systems and interfaces listed; validated or flagged; PRD transport route recorded.

items.title: Interface & Data Flow Inventory
items.description: Catalogue financially relevant interfaces and data flows.
items.gate_requirement: W01 and W02 Checks support the environment gate.

groups.label: Stage 2 — Define Process Scope
groups.summary: Map the business processes and technical areas. Gate G2.

items.title: Module & Business Process Scope
items.description: Map significant FSLIs, SAP modules, business processes and technical areas.
items.gate_requirement: Every significant FSLI mapped; technical areas present; unspecified processes recorded as Outstanding rather than guessed.

groups.label: Stage 3 — Identify Risks
groups.summary: Build the risk register from scoped processes. Gate G3.

items.title: Risk Register
items.description: Define risks against scoped business processes and identify SOX relevance and ownership.
items.gate_requirement: No BP-ID without a risk; SOX risks flagged; owners agreed.

groups.label: Stage 4 — Design the Control Set
groups.summary: Map controls, dependencies, SoD and sensitive access. Gate G4.

items.title: Risk Control Matrix
items.description: Map controls to risks, identify key controls and ITGC dependencies.
items.gate_requirement: No SOX risk without a key control; ITGC dependencies recorded.

items.title: SoD & Sensitive Access Matrix
items.description: Define SoD risks, rules and mitigations.
items.gate_requirement: Every SoD risk has a rule and the ruleset is approved.

groups.label: Stage 5 — Confirm People
groups.summary: Confirm control and evidence ownership. Gate G5.

items.title: Control & Evidence Owner Matrix
items.description: Confirm who owns controls, risks and evidence.
items.gate_requirement: Owners confirmed or escalated; W14 may be issued in scoping form with no conclusion.

groups.label: Stage 6 — Request & Receive Evidence
groups.summary: Request evidence, index it and prove populations. Gate G6.

items.title: PBC Evidence Request Register
items.description: Issue and track evidence requests for controls.
items.dependencies: W05 CTRL-ID and W07 evidence owners

items.title: Evidence Index & IPE Log
items.description: Index evidence, record populations and complete IPE checks before sampling.
items.gate_requirement: Populations received and every IPE result is Pass.

groups.label: Stage 7 — Plan the Tests
groups.summary: Build the design and operating-effectiveness test plan. Gate G7.

items.title: Test Plan
items.description: Plan TOD, TOE, reliance and retests; schedule ITGC testing first.
items.gate_requirement: TOD and TOE for every key control; ITGC tests scheduled first.

groups.label: Stage 8 — Sample & Test
groups.summary: Select samples and execute/review workpapers. Gate G8.

items.title: Sample Selection Log
items.description: Document samples only after the source population has passed IPE.
items.dependencies: W10 TEST-ID and W09 population evidence
items.gate_requirement: Samples logged and agree to workpapers.

items.title: Test Workpapers
items.description: Execute and review testing, linking exceptions to deficiencies or rationale.
items.gate_requirement: Workpapers reviewed by a different person; exceptions carry DEF-ID or rationale.

groups.label: Stage 9 — Evaluate & Conclude
groups.summary: Evaluate deficiencies and produce the coverage conclusion. Gate G9.

items.title: Deficiency & Remediation Log
items.description: Log, group, evaluate and track remediation/retest of deficiencies.
items.gate_requirement: Deficiencies evaluated and remediation/retest status supported.

items.title: Scoping Workpaper & Coverage Dashboard
items.description: Bring risk, control, testing, deficiency and reliance coverage together into the project conclusion.
items.dependencies: W05, W10, W13 and reliance references
items.gate_requirement: Testing-stage coverage checks support the final conclusion.

assessment: The Corvane simulator is organized around project gates G1–G9. A workbook is gate-ready when its built-in checks support the gate and any INFO items have been reviewed and accepted.

study_model: Start with Course Home and the Deployment Guide before opening W01.
Read the relevant online manual and workbook instructions before working in Excel.
Download Excel only when you need to perform the exercise or inspect the workbook.
Preserve IDs, Ref_ tabs, Checks tabs and the Golden Thread.
Submit completed workbooks through the course app when required.
course_home.online_learning_statement: Read the teaching content online first. Download files primarily when you need to work in an exercise, workbook, planning model or submission template.

layers.name: KNOWLEDGE
layers.description: Course overview, directions, manuals, module reading, cases and explanations served online.

layers.name: PRACTICE
layers.description: Workbook exercises, case decisions, planning activities and working files.

layers.name: PERFORMANCE
layers.description: Submission, instructor review, scoring, gates, capstone and certification.
